description: The plot illustrates the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on Qwen2.5, comparing the accuracy achieved by various methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2 to 2000, and is marked at intervals of 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, and is marked at intervals of 5. The plot contains six lines, each representing a different editing method: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, square marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, inverted triangle marker, solid line), MEMIT (purple, diamond marker, solid line), and ROME (green, star marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 63% and ends at around 70%, increasing steadily across the x-axis. The FT line starts at around 65% and ends at around 72%, also increasing steadily. The IKE line starts at around 68% and ends at around 75%, showing a similar trend. The MEND line starts at around 70% and ends at around 77%, increasing steadily. The MEMIT line starts at around 72% and ends at around 78%, showing a steady increase. The ROME line starts at around 74% and ends at around 79%, also increasing steadily across the x-axis.
